retrieved_context_preview.snippet: Ready for some rest, ready to not be covered in the sweat and ichor of the day, Caelynn, Karsemine, Stafl, Baergrom, and Ephanna accepted the offer of a ride to StoneBridge with Pippa.
Adventure hook, hear about a mysterious artifact while celebrating.
Unprepared for the speed with which the river carries Bonogo away, the rope and Bonogo are gone.
In the face of a rapidly deteriorating situation, Karsemine cast Zephyr strike and ran down the bank, shooting arrows at wear Bonogo probably was.
They unfortunately haven't the first clue how to use them, but they are cool!
Thoroughly fermented) Bonogo dives into the river with full trust in Baergrom to hold the rope, which is immediately torn out of Baergrom's hand.
Without missing a beat Bonogo out of selflessness and hopes for a giant fish to eat, dove into the water to find the damned net didn't have a fish, stupid useless net.
The only remenant, the end of the rope whipping across the top of the river, vanishing out of sight.
Along the way down river, they encountered an elderly fisherman, whose net was stuck.
Without missing a beat Bonogo out of selflessness and hopes for a giant fish to eat, dove into the water to find the damned net didn't have a fish, stupid useless net.
Where Ephanna hopped on Bubbles back and followed after the runaway boats.
Pippa a bright and talkative Gnome obsessed with crafting and understanding beer, hitched up Bubbles the Float Goat to her wagon full of kegs and led the crew to a dock and barge on the river.
With some trial and error and stradling of boats Stafl and Baergrom I think pulled the net to surface to see it looked to be the corner beams of a roof.

Finding a sack of gems, some mystery potions on corpses in the well, and perhaps most importantly bashing down a wall to reveal a room full of healing potions and alchemical tools and ingredients of and ancient and incredible design.

Since this room was not part of the original contract, and really neither was the rest of this god forsaken place, they negotiated with Glowkindle for the right to stash gear in the hidden alchemy room.
